content.short: Nordic digital bank with personal and business accounts.
content.description: Lunar is a Nordic digital bank, founded in Denmark as Lunar Way, that offers app-based personal and business banking across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. It provides current accounts, debit and credit cards, savings with competitive rates, budgeting and subscription tracking, instant peer-to-peer payments, and lending, plus dedicated business accounts for entrepreneurs and companies. Holding a European banking licence, Lunar has expanded from a mobile-first consumer app into a broader financial platform, and through its Moonrise arm it offers Nordic account infrastructure to other fintechs. Targeting younger, digitally native customers who want a modern alternative to traditional Scandinavian banks, Lunar combines everyday banking, cards, savings, and business tools in one clean, mobile-centric experience.
